  public getToken()
  public getUser()

  public getList($key)
  public toArray()

class MxApi\Core\Endpoint\AbstractEndpoint
  protected abstract describe()
  protected cursorScope(array $params)
  protected nextCursor(array $state, array $params, $config)
  protected readCursor(array $params, $config)
  protected readPaging(array $params, $config)
  protected readParams(MxApi\Core\Http\Request $request)
  public getMetadata()

class MxApi\Core\Endpoint\EndpointContext
  public __construct(MxApi\Core\Platform\PlatformInterface $platform, MxApi\Core\Config $config, ?MxApi\Core\Auth\AuthContext $auth = null, ?MxApi\Core\Endpoint\EndpointMetadata $metadata = null)
  public getAuth()
  public getConfig()
  public getMetadata()
  public getPlatform()

interface MxApi\Core\Endpoint\EndpointInterface
  public abstract getMetadata()
  public abstract handle(MxApi\Core\Http\Request $request, MxApi\Core\Endpoint\EndpointContext $context)

  public isPublic()

  public isWrite()
  public requiresAuth()

  public toArray()
  public toPublicArray()

class MxApi\Core\Http\ApiException
  public __construct($errorCode, $message, $status = 400, array $details = [])
  public getDetails()
  public getErrorCode()
  public getStatus()
  public static contextNotAllowed($context)
  public static credentialsRequired()
  public static insufficientPermission($permission)
  public static insufficientScope($scope)
  public static internalError($message = 'Внутренняя ошибка API.')
  public static invalidCredentials()
  public static invalidJson()
  public static invalidParameter($parameter, $reason = '')
  public static invalidScope($scope)
  public static invalidToken()
  public static ipNotAllowed($ip)
  public static methodNotAllowed($route, $method, array $allowed = [])
  public static missingParameter($parameter)
  public static notFound($what)
  public static rateLimited($limit)
  public static routeNotFound($route, $method)
  public static serviceDisabled()
  public static tokenExpired()
  public static tokenRequired()
  public static tokenRevoked()
  public static unknownContext($context)
  public static userInactive($reason = 'Пользователь неактивен.')

  public getHeaders()
  public getPayload()
  public getStatus()

  public isStream()
  public send()

  public static success($data = null, array $meta = [], $status = 200)
  public withHeader($name, $value)

interface MxApi\Core\Middleware\MiddlewareInterface
  public abstract process(MxApi\Core\Http\Request $request, MxApi\Core\Endpoint\EndpointContext $context, callable $next)

interface MxApi\Core\Platform\PlatformInterface
  public abstract cacheGet($key, array $options = [])
  public abstract cacheSet($key, $value, $lifetime = 0, array $options = [])
  public abstract checkPermission(MxApi\Core\Platform\PlatformUser $user, $permission)
  public abstract findUserById($id)
  public abstract findUserByUsername($username)
  public abstract getClientRepository()
  public abstract getContextKey()
  public abstract getLogRepository()
  public abstract getOption($key, $default = null)
  public abstract getTokenRepository()
  public abstract invokeEvent($event, array $params = [])
  public abstract log($level, $message, array $context = [])
  public abstract now()
  public abstract runProcessor($processor, array $properties = [], array $options = [])
  public abstract setRuntimeUser(MxApi\Core\Platform\PlatformUser $user)
  public abstract useContext($key)
  public abstract verifyPassword(MxApi\Core\Platform\PlatformUser $user, $password)

  public __construct($id, $username, $sudo = false, $active = true, $blocked = false)
  public getId()
  public getUsername()
  public isActive()
  public isBlocked()
  public isSudo()
  public isUsable()
  public toArray()

  public __construct($success, array $payload = [], $message = '', array $errors = [])
  public getData()
  public getErrors()
  public getMessage()
  public getObject()
  public getPayload()
  public getResults()
  public getTotal()
  public hasObject()
  public isList()
  public isSuccess()

interface MxApi\Core\Provider\ProviderInterface
  public abstract getEndpoints(MxApi\Core\Platform\PlatformInterface $platform, MxApi\Core\Config $config)
  public abstract getId()
  public abstract isAvailable(MxApi\Core\Platform\PlatformInterface $platform)
